description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Repatriation of Export Proceeds in to Sri Lanka Rules No. 5 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made under the Monetary Law Act regarding the repatriation and conversion of export proceeds. It establishes regulatory requirements for exporters and licensed banks, amends previous regulations, and operates within the legal framework of existing banking and foreign exchange acts. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it creates new regulatory requirements and modifies existing financial regulations.
